name: FULL FINGERTIP TACTILE SENSOR
summary: A full-coverage fingertip tactile sensor reporting three-axis resultant force and a force-distribution matrix. It offers different normal-force ranges and sensitivity configurations, UART communication and daisy-chain deployment.
